assets.usage: Website preview generated from diagram 1 in solution.tex; editable source remains inline in solution.tex.

diagram_previews.alt: Graph of the increasing curve y = arctan(x/2) + arctan(2x/3), vertical scale enlarged, between dotted levels pi and -pi. It meets the red line y = pi/4 at the red point x1 to the right of the origin, and the dashed line y = -3pi/4 at the open point x2 far to the left.

difficulty_rationale: An unstated approach requiring some exploration and a few connected steps.
